findings.highlight: This meat nobly tries to save the world.
findings.evidenceJa: この肉はな、健気にも世界を嫌おうとせぬ。
findings.governingReading: 嫌おうとせぬ/嫌わぬよう努める describe resisting hatred of the world because her ally lives in it.
findings.explanation: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.

findings.highlight: The world will never exhaust its hate for the meat, no matter what it does.
findings.evidenceJa: 肉は何をされようと人の世を憎みきれぬ。
findings.governingReading: 肉は何をされようと人の世を憎みきれぬ makes meat the one unable to finish hating, whatever is done to it.
findings.explanation: Victim cannot fully hate despite injury becomes world never stops hating victim despite its actions.

findings.highlight: nothing the meat does will matter.
findings.evidenceJa: 肉には何をしても効果はないのだ。
findings.governingReading: 肉には何をしても効果はない concludes abuse fails to break restraint.
findings.explanation: Doing anything to victim has no effect becomes victim’s actions do not matter.

findings.highlight: He has grown more than expected, but managed to survive this long.
findings.evidenceJa: 予想外の成長ではあったが、あそこまで保たせてくれたのだ。
findings.governingReading: 予想外の成長 resumes the sacrificial subject6–8; boy 保たせてくれた kept it going so he should supply ending.
findings.explanation: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.
